cohort_total_n_excerpt: we conducted a prospective cohort study of 35,171 men aged 50-76 yr in western Washington state.
reason: The study prospectively evaluates development of prostate cancer overall and does not report an aggressive incident prostate cancer analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: No association was found between this level of use of saw palmetto and risk of prostate cancer development [hazard ratio (HR) = 0.95; 95% confidence interval = 0.74-1.23] or with increasing frequency or duration of use.
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported hazard ratio concerns overall prostate cancer development, not an aggressive subtype.
